'''Alfred Dong Brahma Bull's Throne Room''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Alfred Dong]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls135.htm Brahma Bull's Throne Room], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041027134632/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls135.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Alfred Dong]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Strategy:''' Mains And Toys
